corrections.finding: No dedicated player-character numeric progression state existed separately from Living NPC health placeholders.
corrections.resolution: Added CharacterCore with hashed persistent state and explicit GAMEPLAY_DERIVED_NOT_CANON authority.

corrections.finding: Progression events could later double-apply under replay/network retry if implemented as direct writes.
corrections.resolution: Added unique event_ref ledger with hash-based idempotency/conflict detection.

corrections.finding: Character death had no authoritative action gate in Stage01 command routing.
corrections.resolution: Added ALIVE/DEAD vital state; dead characters cannot move or execute primary actions. Respawn remains deferred to Stage13.

corrections.finding: Stage01 regression initially failed transient-artifact policy due to __pycache__ generated by test execution.
corrections.resolution: Removed caches, enforced no-bytecode runners, reran Stage01 validation to 58/58 PASS.

corrections.finding: Initial Stage02 stress harness exceeded execution limit.
corrections.resolution: Reduced redundant world/tick volume while preserving XP, attributes, vitals, replay, persistence and restore invariants; rerun completed 15/15 PASS.
